
To check whether a string begins with a '''cmavo''', first you have to check that it does not begin with a [[Morphology: cmene|cmene]] or with a '''CVCy-lujvo'''.

A '''CVCy-lujvo''' consists of a [[Morphology: rafsi|CVC-rafsi]], then a [[Morphology: vowels]], then any number of [[Morphology: rafsi nitial-rafsi]] (possibly none) and finally a [[Morphology: brivla|brivla-core]].

If the string does not begin with a [[Morphology: cmene|cmene]] or with a '''CVCy-lujvo''', then it begins with a '''cmavo''' if it begins with a '''cmavo-form''' and is followed by a [[Morphology: special characters ause]] or by a [[Morphology: words ojban-word]]. 

A '''cmavo-form''' consists of a non-[[Morphology: consonants]], non-[[Morphology: consonants luster]] [[Morphology: syllables nset]], any number of [[Morphology: syllables ucleus]] (possibly none), and a final [[Morphology: vowels|nucleus]] which is not [[Morphology: syllables tressed]] or, if [[Morphology: syllables tressed]], it is not followed by a [[Morphology: consonants luster]]. A '''cmavo-form''' can also consist of one or more [[Morphology: vowels]]'s in a row, or of a [[Morphology: special characters igit]].
